title: Ponicidin-induced conformational changes of HSP90 regulates the MAPK pathway to relieve ulcerative colitis.
authors: Zhang, Xuerong; Xu, Yuanhang; Fan, Minqi; Lv, Xueqing; Long, Jiachan; Yang, Rong; Zhang, Rong; Liu, Zhongqiu; Gu, Jiangyong; Wu, Peng; Wang, Caiyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究冬凌草甲素通过诱导HSP90构象变化调控MAPK通路缓解溃疡性结肠炎，核心是药物-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于核酸体系。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a recurring chronic intestinal disease that can be debilitating and in severe cases, may further lead to cancer. However, all these treatment techniques still suffer from drug dependence, adverse effects and poor patient compliance. Therefore, there is an urgent need to seek new therapeutic strategies. In traditional Chinese medicine, Rabdosia rubescens (Hemsl.) H.Hara has the effects of clearing heat-toxin and promoting blood circulation to relieve pain, it is wildly used for treating inflammatory diseases such as sore throats and tonsillitis. Ponicidin is an important molecule for the anti-inflammatory effects of Rabdosia rubescens, but it has not been studied in the treatment of colitis. HSP90 is the most critical regulator in the development and progression of inflammatory diseases such as UC. AIM OF THE STUDY: The aim of this study was to explore the anti-inflammatory activity of ponicidin and its mechanism of effect in vitro and in vivo, as well as to identify the target proteins on which ponicidin may interact. MATERIAL AND METHODS: 2.5% (w/v) dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) was used to induce C57BL/6 mice to form an ulcerative colitis model, and then 5 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg ponicidin was given for treatment, while the Rabdosia rubescens extract group and Rabdosia rubescens diterpene extract group were set up for comparison of the efficacy of ponicidin. At the end of modeling and drug administration, mouse colon tissues were taken, and the length of colon was counted, inflammatory factors and inflammatory signaling pathways were detected. RAW264.7 cells were induced to form cell inflammation model with 1 mug/mL Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) for 24 h. 1 muM, 2 muM and 4 muM ponicidin were given at the same time, and after the end of the modeling and administration of the drug, the inflammatory factors and inflammatory signaling pathways were detected by qRT-PCR, western blotting, immunofluorescence and other methods. In vitro, target angling and combined with mass spectrometry were used to search for relevant targets of ponicidin, while isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), protease degradation experiments and molecular dynamics simulations were used for further confirmation of the mode of action and site of action between ponicidin and target proteins. RESULTS: Ponicidin can alleviate DSS and LPS-induced inflammation by inhibiting the MAPK signaling pathway at the cellular and animal levels. In vitro, we confirmed that ponicidin can interact with the middle domain of HSP90 and induce the conformational changes in the N-terminal domain. CONCLUSION: These innovative efforts identified the molecular target of ponicidin in the treatment of UC and revealed the molecular mechanism of its interaction with HSP90.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是一种复发性慢性肠道疾病，可能使人衰弱，严重时甚至可能进一步导致癌症。然而，所有这些治疗方法仍存在药物依赖性、不良反应和患者依从性差等问题。因此，迫切需要寻求新的治疗策略。在传统中医中，冬凌草（Rabdosia rubescens (Hemsl.) H.Hara）具有清热解毒、活血止痛的功效，广泛用于治疗咽喉炎、扁桃体炎等炎症性疾病。冬凌草甲素（Ponicidin）是冬凌草抗炎作用的重要分子，但尚未在结肠炎治疗中进行研究。HSP90是UC等炎症性疾病发生和发展中最关键的调节因子。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨冬凌草甲素的抗炎活性及其在体外和体内的作用机制，并鉴定冬凌草甲素可能相互作用的靶蛋白。材料与方法：使用2.5%（w/v）葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导C57BL/6小鼠形成溃疡性结肠炎模型，然后给予5 mg/kg和10 mg/kg冬凌草甲素治疗，同时设置冬凌草提取物组和冬凌草二萜提取物组以比较冬凌草甲素的疗效。建模和给药结束后，取小鼠结肠组织，统计结肠长度，检测炎症因子和炎症信号通路。用1 μg/mL脂多糖（LPS）诱导RAW264.7细胞形成细胞炎症模型24小时，同时给予1 μM、2 μM和4 μM冬凌草甲素，建模和给药结束后，通过qRT-PCR、western blotting、免疫荧光等方法检测炎症因子和炎症信号通路。在体外，使用靶点垂钓结合质谱法寻找冬凌草甲素的相关靶点，同时使用等温滴定量热法（ITC）、蛋白酶降解实验和分子动力学模拟进一步确认冬凌草甲素与靶蛋白之间的作用方式和作用位点。结果：冬凌草甲素可通过抑制MAPK信号通路在细胞和动物水平上缓解DSS和LPS诱导的炎症。在体外，我们确认冬凌草甲素可与HSP90的中间结构域相互作用，并诱导N端结构域的构象变化。结论：这些创新性工作确定了冬凌草甲素治疗UC的分子靶点，并揭示了其与HSP90相互作用的分子机制。
